observations: The Trigger7 source pin explicitly leaves livekit/eot-bench-data dataset_revision unresolved and records Hugging Face license metadata as cc-by-4.0.
The pinned LiveKit eot-bench README describes livekit/eot-bench-data as Apache-2.0 alongside the benchmark repository.

Current Hugging Face dataset discovery still surfaces livekit/eot-bench-data under the cc-by-4.0 license filter and exposes the German validation subset, but this does not identify the immutable dataset commit consumed by a future run.
The Hugging Face Files/versions surface returned HTTP 429 during this pass, so no dataset revision was guessed or inferred from update timestamps.
reason: The handoff requires an exact Hugging Face dataset revision plus governing dataset license at that revision before execution. Neither requirement is closed; starting the NAMO benchmark now would break its own provenance contract.
